nodes.description: Private mapping (address => uint256) holding token balances; mutated in transfer, transferFrom, _mint and _burn.
Nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) of ERC20 allowances.
Hardcoded developer wallet address that receives the development share and gates degen mode toggles.
Fixed-size address[3] ring buffer of the three most recent traders rewarded by the burn redistribution.
Public total supply variable, reduced by burns inside the degen path.
Fee percentage (5) used by amountToTake to compute the burn amount.
Boolean switch that enables the 5% burn/redistribution tokenomics.
Public ERC20 transfer; applies burn/redistribution when degenMode is on, otherwise performs a plain balance move.
Public allowance-based transfer replicating the same degen burn logic and decreasing the allowance.
Public batch transfer looping over receivers/amounts arrays and invoking transfer() internally.
Public approval setter writing _allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Public helper that adds to an existing allowance.
Public helper that subtracts from an existing allowance.
Internal mint executed from the constructor to create the initial supply.
External burn that destroys the caller's own tokens via _burn.
Internal burn decrementing _totalSupply and the target balance.
External allowance-based burn that decrements the allowance then calls _burn.
Public function enabling degen mode; guarded only by msg.sender == devWallet.
Public function disabling degen mode; guarded only by msg.sender == devWallet.
View helper computing value * basePercent / 100, the amount removed from each transfer.
Payable constructor that sets token metadata and mints the whole supply to msg.sender.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance keys and the dev wallet check.
Batch mutation of several _balances entries (to, previousDegen, degenWallets, devWallet) inside one transfer when degenMode is true.
_totalSupply.sub(tokensToBurn) permanently reduces supply during the degen path.
multiTransfer executes the public transfer() function repeatedly in an unbounded loop with caller-supplied array lengths.
value parameter of transfer, the amount to move before the 5% haircut.
to parameter of transfer, the recipient address.
from parameter of transferFrom, the account whose allowance and balance are spent.
value parameter of transferFrom, checked against balance and allowance.
receivers array parameter of multiTransfer, used as the loop bound and destination list.
amounts array parameter of multiTransfer, indexed in parallel with receivers.
spender parameter of approve/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance, the allowance grantee.
amount parameter of burn/_burn, the quantity of tokens destroyed.
account parameter of burnFrom/_burn, the address whose tokens are burned.
Local caching degenWallets[0] before the ring buffer is rotated, used as a reward recipient.
Local holding amountToTake(value), the total 5% fee deducted from the transfer.
Local holding totalLoss/5, simultaneously the burned amount and each reward payout.
Local holding the remainder after four tokensToBurn subtractions, sent to devWallet.
Local holding value minus totalLoss, the net amount actually delivered to the recipient.
Loop counter of multiTransfer, iterating over the receiver array.
Local inside amountToTake equal to value*basePercent/100.

edges.reason: msg.sender selects and mutates its own balance entry in the degen transfer path.
previousDegen is read from degenWallets[0] before the ring buffer is rotated.
previousDegen receives tokensToBurn, feeding a balance write.
totalLoss is derived from the value parameter through amountToTake.
basePercent multiplies the value inside amountToTake to produce amountLost.
amountLost is returned by amountToTake and stored as totalLoss.
tokensToBurn is computed as totalLoss.div(5).
tokensToDev is totalLoss minus four tokensToBurn shares.
tokensToTransfer is value.sub(totalLoss).
tokensToBurn is the argument of the _totalSupply.sub burn arithmetic.
_totalSupply is read and reduced inside the burn arithmetic.
tokensToBurn is credited to previousDegen and the degen wallets.
tokensToTransfer is credited to the recipient balance.
tokensToDev is credited to the devWallet balance.
The burn share is ultimately written into the _balances mapping.
transfer reads _balances[msg.sender] to validate and subtract the sent amount.
The degenMode flag gates the whole burn/redistribution branch.
enableDegenMode requires msg.sender to equal the hardcoded devWallet.
enableDegenMode authorization depends on the caller identity.
disableDegenMode requires msg.sender to equal the hardcoded devWallet.
disableDegenMode authorization depends on the caller identity.
multiTransfer drives the repeated internal transfer execution.
The loop counter bounds how many times transfer is re-executed.
multiTransfer invokes the public transfer function for every receiver/amount pair.
msg.sender determines the branch, balance checks and event emitters inside transfer.
burnFrom forwards the account argument into the burn routine.
burn forwards the amount argument into _burn.

normalization_plan.reason: The value parameter is only meaningful as input to the transfer function's burn and payout math.
The to parameter is consumed directly by transfer for the recipient balance credit.
The from parameter is the spender source consumed by transferFrom's balance and allowance logic.
The value parameter feeds transferFrom's checks and degen burn computation.
The receivers array defines the loop bound of the repeated internal transfer execution.
The amounts array is consumed item-by-item by the repeated internal transfer execution.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance mapping key in approve.
The amount parameter is the quantity destroyed by the burn entry point.
The account parameter selects whose allowance and balance burnFrom destroys.
The cached previous degen wallet is immediately used as a recipient in the batch balance write.
The total fee local is only intermediate state feeding the batch balance redistribution.
tokensToBurn is the exact argument used to decrement the total supply.
The developer share local is written into the devWallet balance entry.
The net transfer local is written into the recipient balance entry.
The loop counter exists solely to drive multiTransfer's iteration.
The amountLost local is simply the computed return value of amountToTake.
